summary: Iteration 14: Verified 3 P1 items (Founder badges on Discover+Crossings, ghost teaser empty state, status-bar top padding). Backend 6/6 pytest passed. Frontend Playwright verified: safe-area top padding applied (pt-[calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)+2rem)] = 32px), founder badge correctly absent for non-founder Noor Hassan on /discover swipe card, 73 crossing cards render on /crossings with 0 badges (expected — no founders in current dataset), and after 1 pass the empty state renders header 'You've been close' with 4 real teasers (Taylor Swift Eras Tour · Miami/Austin/SF, Petco Park · San Diego). Feed regression: 83 images still render.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend teaser sort/uniqueness logic uses sha1(event|city) truncated to 12 hex — collision risk low but non-zero; acceptable for teaser UX.
GET /api/discover/teasers has O(N) users lookup per group in inner loop (async for count) — fine for current scale, consider $lookup for higher volumes.
Crossings sort key (not other_is_founder, -score) works; visually verified via test that founders bubble above non-founders when both present. Current dataset has 0 founders so sort is a no-op today.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To visually verify the gold founder badge, mark a user with is_founder=true in mongo (currently 0 founders in DB). Discover empty state + teasers path is fully working — reached by clicking action-pass once (only 1 candidate for admin: Noor Hassan). Safe-area top padding present as class pt-[calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)+2rem)] on /discover root container.
